selected_evidence.summary: The active configuration contains both safeguards; attempted loads resolve to /bin/true and usb_storage remains absent.

selected_evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, the policy persisted, module-init-tools parsed it, both module-name variants were intercepted, and usb_storage remained unloaded.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-change and post-reboot output both report CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 3456ae42-fb81-4f2d-8000-000000000000, reboot acknowledgement and outage, changed boot ID 19c329f0-a1fb-4fdc-8000-000000000000, then recovered filesystem, SSH service, persistent configuration, and module enforcement.
